LLM auditresponse for PKGBUILD:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD file defines a standard Arch Linux package build process for `texlive-emo-full`, which provides LaTeX emoji support. The source is fetched from a legitimate upstream GitHub release URL (`https://github.com/apparebit/emo/releases/download/v1.0/emo-1.0.zip`) and has a matching, valid SHA-256 checksum. The build process consists of unpacking the zip archive, running `pdftex emo.dtx` to generate documentation or style files, and installing the resulting files into the appropriate TeX directory structure under `$pkgdir`.

All operations are confined to standard packaging practices: use of `unzip`, `install`, and `cp` to extract and place files, with no network access, code generation, or execution of external scripts during build or install. The package depends only on `texlive-latexextra` and `unzip`, both reasonable for its purpose. There are no signs of obfuscation, data exfiltration, or execution of downloaded code. The license metadata reflects the mixed licensing of the upstream project.

The file operations are limited to the build directory and the package directory, with no access to user data or system-wide configuration changes. Post-install hooks or systemd units are absent, which is expected for a static LaTeX package. The documentation and PDF are installed in standard locations. Overall, the PKGBUILD adheres to safe, transparent packaging norms.
</details>
